conflicts_text: Players praise the expanded creator commentary and rebuilt presentation, while some previous owners question paying for a similar core puzzle campaign or criticize technical limits.
notes_text: Feedback on Braid, Anniversary Edition (exact AppID 499180, separate from the 2008 original) generally values the challenging time-manipulation puzzles and the revised visuals, audio and substantial developer commentary. A May 2024 community appreciation post welcomes comparisons between original and updated visuals and the extra creative context. Steam review excerpts describe the familiar puzzle quality and documentary features positively but include reservations over upgrade value and display/performance limits reported by individual users. The retrospective base-game praise should not be mistaken for independent evidence of Anniversary-specific technical improvements.

source_log.observation: Exact Anniversary Edition AppID 499180 Steam product checked for edition identity, expanded commentary and visuals.
May 21 2024 player discussion appreciates remaster, art comparison and commentary; direct opening not confirmed.
Indexed individual Steam user feedback mentions puzzle quality, documentary value, cost-to-upgrade concerns and claimed 1080p/60 limit; not independently tested.

unknowns_text: Steam individual helpful review text was indexed but not fully checked inside its dynamic review region. Reported resolution/framerate limitation was not independently reproduced or verified for all hardware; price-to-value is subjective.
